bullBear.title: Bull / Base / Bear + Advocatus Diaboli
bullBear.intro: The AI works through three scenarios with probabilities and then plays "Advocatus Diaboli" — deliberately arguing against the prevailing view. Not investment advice.

dcf.title: DCF fair value
dcf.cardSubtitle: Discounted cash flow with bull/base/bear scenarios + reverse DCF (what growth is priced in?)

reverse.title: Reverse DCF
reverse.subtitle: — what growth justifies the current price?

dcf.footer: Two-stage DCF with Gordon-growth terminal value. WACC as discount rate. All scenarios use the same terminal growth and WACC — bear/bull differ only in phase-1 growth (±4% vs. base). Not investment advice.

financials.currencyNote: Currency: {currency}. Yahoo Finance provides up to 4 years of historical annual statements.

indicators.title: AI indicator evaluation
indicators.needIndicators: Activate at least one indicator above in the chart (RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands etc.), then the AI can evaluate it.
indicators.tooltipNoIndicators: First activate indicators in the chart
indicators.disclaimer: ⚠️ Technical analysis is not a buy signal. Combine with fundamentals and your own assessment.

vision.title: Vision-based pattern recognition
vision.intro: The AI analyzes a chart image visually and identifies classic patterns (cup-and-handle, flag, double bottom etc.), marks support/resistance and gives a concrete trade setup. Either from the current chart or uploaded (e.g. TradingView screenshot).
vision.tooltipCurrent: Take a screenshot of the chart above and analyze it
vision.errorNotReady: Chart not ready — please wait a moment and try again.
vision.errorFileType: Please select an image file (PNG, JPG, WebP)
vision.disclaimer: ⚠️ Visual pattern recognition by AI is not a buy signal. Patterns can be interpreted subjectively. Your own assessment and risk management remain important.

consensus.title: Multi-model consensus
consensus.intro: Lets the same stock be analyzed by all configured AI providers and shows where they agree or disagree. Only available when ≥ 2 keys are set in Settings.
consensus.costHint: Estimate based on typical prompt size for this stock.

earningsReaction.title: Earnings reaction analysis
earningsReaction.intro: Analyzes the most recent earnings event: beat/miss on EPS and revenue, guidance from news, market reaction (5-day and 30-day price). AI assesses whether the move is over- or under-reacting and gives a recommendation for your position.

insider.title: Insider trades
insider.subtitle: Form-4 transactions (last ~6 months)
insider.empty: No insider transactions available for this ticker.
insider.source: Source: Yahoo Finance / SEC Form 4. Data delayed, often only available for US tickers.

proScores.title: Pro scores & market signals
proScores.subtitle: Fundamental quality, bankruptcy risk, valuation, short interest, analyst revisions

piotroski.title: Piotroski F-Score
piotroski.missing: Not available — missing balance sheet data.

proScores.disclaimer: All scores derived from public Yahoo Finance data. Piotroski / Altman / Beneish / Graham are academic models that may be inconclusive for financials (banks, insurers, REITs).

thesis.intro: Capture your buy thesis in writing. Run an AI check to validate the thesis against current facts — immediately or later. This way you can see whether your buy arguments still hold.

fields.thesisPlaceholder: Your thesis: Why are you buying? Which assumption carries it?
fields.exitPlaceholder: Exit criteria (optional): When do you sell? Stop loss, target, time horizon

thesis.closePrompt: How was it closed? (e.g. Sold, thesis refuted, target reached)
thesis.aiCheckTooltip: AI checks thesis against current facts

positionSizing.title: Position sizing
positionSizing.intro: The AI computes a position size considering your portfolio, your existing position in {ticker}, and your risk profile.
positionSizing.disclaimer: ⚠️ Not investment advice. Own due diligence required.

notes.title: My notes
notes.intro: Personal notes on {ticker} — e.g. investment thesis, observations, earnings expectations. Only visible to you. Pinned notes appear at the top.
notes.empty: No notes yet — create the first one above.

relationships.title: Business network
relationships.intro: Shows who has {ticker} ({name}) as customer, supplier, partner or competitor — based on publicly documented business relationships. Initial analysis ~30s (then cached for 30 days).
relationships.disclaimer: ⚠️ The AI generates the network from its training knowledge. Known relationships are usually accurate, very new or small connections may be missing. When in doubt — check the company's quarterly report.

wikipedia.title: Wikipedia attention
wikipedia.empty: No data — likely no matching Wikipedia article for "{name}". If the admin has not configured a user agent for the Wikipedia API, the source is server-side disabled.
wikipedia.intro: Daily views of the article <link>"{article}"</link> — as an attention proxy.

googleTrends.title: Google search interest
googleTrends.empty: No trend data available — Google returns too few data points for "{keyword}" or rejected the request (temporary rate limit).
googleTrends.intro: Relative search interest for "{keyword}" ({geo}) — 0–100 normalized to the maximum within the observation window.

reddit.title: Reddit buzz
reddit.empty: No notable mentions in this period.
reddit.footer: Note: Reddit sentiment is noisy. Mood, not facts.

stocktwits.title: Stocktwits
stocktwits.intro: Trader sentiment from recent Stocktwits posts — the platform specializes in stock discussion, many posts are explicitly tagged "Bullish" or "Bearish".
stocktwits.notAvailable: Symbol not available on Stocktwits (German tickers are often not listed there).
